description:
The project currently defines two blocks. The first is a **header** block located at `src/blocks/header`; it is a folder rather than a single file. Inside this folder you’ll find three entries: a plain‑text identifier “html”, a custom header template named **headerTemplate** whose source lives at `templates/header.html`, and an intentionally empty slot (null) reserved for future use. The block also has a `file` attribute set to null, indicating no single file representation. The second block is a **style** block stored as a file at `src/blocks/style.css`. This block is marked as a file and contains one file definition: a CSS file named **css** that uses the template `templates/style.css`.

In addition to the block definitions, the configuration lists the available file formats. The **HTML** format is identified by the key “html” and is based on the base template `templates/base.html`. The **CSS** format, keyed as “css”, references the base stylesheet template `templates/base.css`. These format definitions provide the default templates that the blocks can inherit or override as needed.
